profile.what: Lupin is India's eighth-largest drug maker by domestic sales (IQVIA MAT Jun-26) and the third-largest generic company in the US by prescriptions (IQVIA, quarter to Jun-26). FY26 sales Rs27,487.5 cr: US 42%, India 30%, other developed markets (Europe, Canada, Australia) 12%, emerging markets (Brazil, South Africa, Philippines, Mexico and others) 13%, API 4%. 15 manufacturing sites, 7 research centres, 26,000+ staff (Q1FY27).

accounting.basis: Screener 'Sales' = revenue from operations incl. other operating income (export/PLI incentives: Rs470.5 cr FY26, Rs59.7 cr Q1FY27). Screener 'Operating profit' (annual) = company EBITDA excluding forex and other income (FY26 Rs8,160 cr). Screener's annual 'Other income' = other income + forex gain - exceptional items (FY26: 424.5 + 656.5 - 557.9 = 523). In quarters Screener keeps forex in operating profit.

exceptionals.item: Arbitration award income and provision reversal (Lupin Atlantis)

accounting.noExceptionalsFy23to25: The company reported no exceptional items in FY23-FY25 (Screener shows small 'exceptional' amounts in those years that are its own reclassification). FY22's Glumetza settlement (Rs1,878 cr) was shown as a separate 'business compensation' line and the Solosec impairment in depreciation, not as exceptional items.
accounting.mirabegronLicence: USD75mn prepaid option capitalised and amortised from Feb-2026 to Sep-2027 (~USD3.8mn a month, ~Rs105 cr a quarter): the main reason D&A rose to Rs453 cr in Q1FY27 from Rs299 cr
accounting.rd: R&D expensed: Rs1,797 cr (8.1%) FY25, Rs2,063 cr (7.5%) FY26, Rs608 cr (7.4%) Q1FY27; ~8% guided for FY27
accounting.workingCapital: Operating working capital 87 days (Mar-26, 110 days a year earlier), 90 days (Jun-26)

Tolvaptan launched with 180-day exclusivity; stays the only generic for over a year
